filter_and_description:
Show products that meet all of the selected conditions.
E.g. if you select two grape varieties, only products containing both are shown.

Show products that meet at least one of the selected conditions.
E.g. if you select two manufacturers, all products from both manufacturers are shown.

info_github_feedback: You can send feature requests and bug reports via GitHub.
info_in_app_feedback: You can also quickly report a problem straight from the app with the Feedback button below.
info_email: For other enquiries, send an email to
info_feeds_before: You can subscribe to price changes and new products via an
info_sources_catalog: The product selection is loaded from Alko's interfaces. The file is updated roughly every six hours. You can download the file used by Alkometriikka
info_sources_availability: Store and product availability data is loaded from the same interfaces and updated at the same time as the product selection. For this reason the availability data may not be completely up to date. You can download the current store and availability data
info_sources_removed: The "removed products" in the selection are based on data Alkometriikka has collected earlier. The data therefore does not include every product ever removed, only those collected before the product left the selection. For this reason the information cannot be considered fully reliable.
personal_description: These details affect the BAC estimates. The details you enter are stored only locally and are not sent anywhere. If you don't enter any details, the BAC estimates are based on default values.
